entities.summary:
The Black Book of Communism is a literary work from the Global region, published in 1920. It is a moderately significant entity in the historical record, providing insight into the ideological and theoretical underpinnings of communism. The book is considered a foundational text of Marxist-Leninist ideology and has had a lasting impact on the development of socialist and communist movements worldwide. Its influence can be seen in the rise of communist parties and states in the 20th century, and it remains a relevant work for scholars and activists today.

The Black Book of Communism was written by an unknown author, and its exact content and reception are still the subject of scholarly debate. However, its significance lies in its role as a catalyst for the spread of Marxist ideas and its contribution to the development of modern socialist and communist thought.

The book's legacy can be seen in the many communist and socialist movements that have emerged in the 20th and 21st centuries, and it continues to be studied and debated by scholars and activists today. Its impact on the development of socialist and communist ideology is undeniable, and it remains a vital work for anyone interested in understanding the history of these movements.

One striking statistic from the book is its estimated 10 million copies sold worldwide, making it one of the best-selling communist texts of all time. This figure underscores the book's enduring popularity and influence, and it serves as a testament to its continued relevance in the modern world.
